end.summary:
Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Used a Ludo die, spaceship cockpit, candle and other examples.
Identified cylinder as having two circular flat faces and a pointed candle as a cone.
Initially mixed up shape names when objects were turned; this was corrected later by recognising an upside-down cone as still a cone.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3D shapes through familiar toys and objects, including Aditya’s spaceship. Aditya used the idea of flat faces to describe a cylinder and identified a pointed candle as a cone. There was a mix-up about whether turning a shape changes its name, but Aditya corrected this later by saying an upside-down cone is still a cone. At home, ask them to find and name one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere around the house, even when each object is turned.
